title: Foundation models of human behaviour: Centaur and Psych-101
summary: Centaur, a language model fine-tuned on Psych-101's trial-by-trial transcripts from 160 experiments; held-out participants within experiments against held-out experiments; the out-of-distribution tests; where the summary claims outrun one reported test; what the evaluation does and does not license.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the outline below names its scope and sources.

preparation.description: Read the article and its abstract (published version, on PubMed Central; read in the browser).
Read the evaluation metric: negative log-likelihood on held-out participants.
Read the generalisation section, with its six further paradigms.
